title: STEAM AND EMBERS
why: His order of 2026-10-12, the graphics program (item 9, atmosphere), in the gritty grounded look he picked. COLD STORAGE is a cold store whose machines still run, and nothing on it breathed. Now about half its buildings have a refrigeration vent on the ground outside the south wall, puffing a slow column of steam that rises, spreads and leans with its own draught. And a machine you have vented with a weak spot shot throws a few sparks off its back while it cools, only while you can see it. The vents are placed from the building shapes alone and every puff runs on the raid clock, so nothing random is drawn; THE COLD MILE has none. Fewer puffs and sparks on Effects LOW. Drawing only.
now: Steam rises from vents on COLD STORAGE and a vented machine throws sparks.
